skill.summary: 模拟登录太空，支持多目的地选择，状态查询及安全退出，实现轨道认证与权限管理。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the 太空登录 (space-login) Skill.
- Implements space login, identity & orbit authentication, and permission management.
- Supports multiple destinations (e.g., Moon, Mars, ISS) and spaceship binding.
- Provides status check, logout, and real-time orbit sync functions.
- Includes installation guide, API reference, configuration instructions, and usage examples.
- Documentation written in Chinese with rich details and support information.
